ti.title: ብዘይ ነዳዲ
ti.lyrics:
[[chorus]]
ተማሪኸ ንኽብሪ ንሓርነት
ተቓጺለ ብፍቕሪ ብናትካ ውዕለት
ከናፍረይ ምስጋናኻ ክነግራ
ኣፍደገኻ ክነብር ፍቐደለይ ሓደራ
[[/chorus]]

ብዘይ ነዳዲ ፍቕርኻ ኣቃጺሉኒ
ብዘይግዴታ ውዕለትካ ማሪኹኒ
ፍቕርኻ ንዓይ ከመስግነካ ገዲዱኒ
ሰንሰለተይ ኣውዲቑ ፈዊሱኒ

ርኹስ መንፈስ ኣርሒቕካለይ ሓዪለ
እምነት ፍቕሪ ተስፋ ውህበት ተቐቢለ
ብየማንካ ተጎዝጊዘ ተደጊፈ
ናይዛ ዓለም መከራ መፈንጠራ ሓሊፈ

ደብረ ሰላም ቅዱስ ሚካኤል (ዓዲ ቀይሕ)

ti_ro.title: Bzey nedadi
ti_ro.lyrics:
Bzey nedadi fqrkha aqatsiluni
Bzeygdeta wletka marikhuni
Fqrkha nay kemesgneka gediduni
Senseletey awdiqu fewisuni
Temarikhe nkhbri nharnet
Teqatsile bfqri bnatka wlet
Kenafrey msganakha knegra
Afdegekha knebr fqedeley hadera
Rkhus menfes arhiqkaley hayile
Mnet fqri tesfa whbet teqebile
Byemanka tegozgize tedegife
Nayza alem mekera mefentera halife
Bado nere fre zeyblu gereb
Zeyestewl chnqi mekera zqleb
Nmot tselmat htsuy nere ntfat
Fqrkha arikhani natsa wetsie kab tselmat
Debre selam qdus mikael (adi qeyh)
